prompts.promptText: Walk new hires through the stages a support ticket moves through from open to resolved, and make clear which stage a given ticket is in right now.
Show which of our Q4 launch milestones are already done, which one we're on now, and what's still ahead.
Explain how an order moves from cart to payment to confirmation, and show that we're currently sitting at the payment step.
Give a quick visual of our onboarding checklist's progress: the steps already completed, the one in progress, and what's left.
Compare monthly revenue across our four regions, and call out the top performer.
Give me a quick snapshot of active users, churn rate, and average session length for this week.
Rank our five best-selling products by units sold, and show total units sold this month as a headline number.
Compare Q1 vs Q2 spend across our three departments, and highlight the department that grew the most.
Let the reviewer rate this design submission out of five stars.
Give the user three delivery-time options to choose from, and let them see which one they picked.
Set up a simple two-player turn-based grid game they can play against each other while they wait for a match.
Let someone vote for their favorite of three color options, then rate how confident they are in that pick.
